title: ALIGN: Prompt-based Attribute Alignment for Reliable, Responsible, and Personalized LLM-based Decision-Making
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It measured demographic alignment (geographic region, education, income) and value alignment in medical triage (protocol focus, fairness, risk aversion, continuing care, moral desert, utilitarianism).
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith.
